findings.observation: Both preprint manuscript and published journal article explicitly cite the same derived Southeast US rainfall index DOI. Product identity as a cited dataset is source-backed, but its own repository metadata, specific award attribution, and REACH/Scout uniqueness remain unverified.

Published journal article explicitly cites a Zenodo archive for CCSM4 HRC/LRC simulations; the available preprint PDF instead says CCSM4 model codes, experiments and data outputs were available from University of Miami authors on request. This is a material documentation/version difference, not proof of dataset novelty or same-project WPO funding.
